convention: Game space: metres, +Y up. Weapons: barrel along -Z, origin = grip hand point (socket_grip). mounts.* are offsets from the origin and also exist as named empty nodes in each GLB (mount_optic top rail, mount_muzzle muzzle centre, mount_under under-barrel, mount_mag magazine well bottom, mount_stock stock butt). Measured by tools/blender/postprocess.py: muzzle end = end with the smaller cross-section, grip = hanging spike right behind the magazine (bullpups: frontmost spike; pistols: deepest rear slice); manual corrections live in assets/weapons/frames.override.json (grip = fraction of length from the stock end, flip = swap ends). Attachments: origin = mount_base (bottom centre of the rail clamp), front along -Z, mount_front = front face. Standard rail: attachments snap mount_base onto a weapon mount_* node.
